sourceText:
Pan Fried Lamb Chops
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:36pm

Ingredients




8 lamb rib or loin chops
2 cloves garlic, crushed
Salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
2 teaspoons vegetable oil
2 lemon wedges

Preparation

1 A half-hour before cooking, trim all but a small ribbon of fat from the chops, blot with a paper towel, rub both sides with the garlic and sprinkle with the salt and pepper. 2 Heat the oil in a heavy nonstick skillet. Brown chops on both sides, about 1 minute on each. Lower the heat to medium and cook 4 minutes longer for medium-rare (deduct 2 minutes for rare, add 2 minutes for well). 3 Squeeze lemon over each just before serving. 4 This method works well for chops up to 1 inch thick. If thicker, stir in a little wine, water or broth after searing and cook to desired degree of doneness. 5 Lydecker
